title: Can I BEAT Circular Chess?
summary: Circular Chess on Deckmate (beta, solo dev Green Lemon Games). He plays White vs the experimental Circular Chess Bot at Level 1 (Level 2 recommended) and draws by threefold repetition. Board: 20 files a-t x 8 rings (rank 1 outer, rank 8 inner), hole in the middle, 152 squares (two outer rings missing on side sectors i, j, s, t). Two extra knights per side on the inner ring. Pawns move to the centre, promote to R/B/N.
rules: Board: annulus of 20 sectors (files a-t, counter-clockwise from a at lower left) x 8 rings; rank 1 = outer ring, rank 8 = inner ring; hole in the middle (frames maxres2/3 measured; dev video 2lIS76dOB2Q '152 squares').
Missing squares: i1 i2 j1 j2 s1 s2 t1 t2 ('eight squares are missing from the outside middle of the board to protect the back rank', dev video 0:20; frames).
Ranks are rings and come full circle (transcript 1:26); files run radially and end at the hole (inferred: no piece crosses the hole in either video).

Diagonals step one file and one ring; they end at the inner ring, the outer edge and missing squares, no bouncing (1:41). The four seams on the axes are drawing only: the video's Queen i8xc2 crosses the d|e seam.

Setup: R N B Q K B N R on a1-h1 and R N B K Q B N R on k1-r1 (Black's king n1 faces e1), pawns on rank 2 of each wing, extra knights White j8 s8, Black i8 t8 (dev video 0:27 'two additional knights placed on the inside middle, positioned so the respective bishops can easily defend them': c1->j8, f1->s8, p1->i8, m1->t8; dev video frames).
Pawns of both colours move toward the centre (double step from rank 2) and promote on rank 8 to a rook, bishop or knight only (dev video 0:36).
Castling as in chess (6:20; dev video 0:44); check, checkmate, stalemate as in chess (dev video 0:56). En passant kept as in chess (not shown; inferred).
win_condition: Checkmate the bot (video result: draw by threefold repetition vs level 1).

opponent.name: Circular Chess Bot (experimental), Level 1
opponent.avatar_description: Blue-grey rounded square robot face, two orange pill eyes, white grille mouth with black bars (still maxres2).

board.shape_notes: Annulus 20 sectors x 8 rings, hole radius 72 / ring 35.5 / outer 356 on a 712 px board; side sectors i,j,s,t end at ring 3. a1 dark. Fine seams on the d|e, i|j, n|o, s|t axes.
board.theme_notes: Deckmate teal background #0dd7bf; last move pale yellow; move dots dark brown; letters in each sector's outer cell, rank numbers down the a and k edges.
